entities.summary: Mervyn Allister King, Baron King of Lothbury, is a British economist and public servant who was Governor of the Bank of England from 2003 to 2013. Emeritus Professor of the London School of Economics and Chairman of the Philharmonia since 2020, Lord King serves as President of Marylebone Cricket Club for 2024/25.
